name: Park Jun-yong
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A South Korean middleweight from World Top Team (19-7, age 35), a UFC veteran who lost a decision to Ikram Aliskerov in October 2025 after decision wins over Brad Tavares and Ismail Naurdiev.

how_they_fight.Grappling: Wrestles and takes the back; six submissions in our data.
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped once by strikes (Gregory Rodrigues, R2).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Goes the distance often (eight decisions and splits).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Grinds out close fights; three split-decision wins.
